$comment: Every --ex-* custom property core/shell/shell.css, the diagram base classes (.ex-diagram, .ex-box, .ex-box-changed, .ex-box-new, .ex-ln, .ex-t, .ex-t-muted, .ex-legend-same/-changed/-new), and core/patterns/* consume. A brand file (brand/<id>.css — core's neutral.css, or a project's own) must define every one of these, as literal values, for both light and dark (prefers-color-scheme plus a [data-theme] override). lib/brand.mjs's validateBrand checks this at build time (missing tokens fail the build) and backs check script too. Font stacks are NOT brand tokens: they are system stacks hardcoded directly in shell.css , since they don't vary by brand.

tokens.name: --ex-bg
tokens.role: Page background

tokens.name: --ex-bg-elevated
tokens.role: Raised surface background (menu, info box/panel, cards)

tokens.name: --ex-bg-sunken
tokens.role: Recessed background (code blocks, hover rows)

tokens.name: --ex-ink
tokens.role: Primary text color

tokens.name: --ex-ink-muted
tokens.role: Secondary text color

tokens.name: --ex-ink-faint
tokens.role: Faint/tertiary text (eyebrow, captions, pager labels)

tokens.name: --ex-border
tokens.role: Default hairline border color

tokens.name: --ex-border-strong
tokens.role: Emphasized border color (hover/active/focus-adjacent)

tokens.name: --ex-accent
tokens.role: Primary accent color (links, active menu item, toggles)

tokens.name: --ex-accent-ink
tokens.role: Text/icon color on top of a solid accent fill

tokens.name: --ex-accent-soft
tokens.role: Soft accent background (active menu item, term popover focus)

tokens.name: --ex-focus
tokens.role: Focus-visible outline color

tokens.name: --ex-shadow
tokens.role: Elevation box-shadow value (full CSS value, e.g. two comma-separated shadows)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-same
tokens.role: Diagram legend/stroke: unchanged element (green = same)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-same-bg
tokens.role: Diagram legend/fill: unchanged element

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-changed
tokens.role: Diagram legend/stroke: changed element, .ex-box-changed's stroke (amber = changed)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-changed-bg
tokens.role: Diagram legend/fill: changed element, .ex-box-changed's fill

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-new
tokens.role: Diagram legend/stroke: new element, .ex-box-new's stroke (blue dashed = new)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-new-bg
tokens.role: Diagram legend/fill: new element, .ex-box-new's fill

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-text
tokens.role: Diagram SVG text fill (.ex-t)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-text-muted
tokens.role: Diagram SVG secondary text fill (.ex-t-muted)

tokens.name: --ex-diagram-line
tokens.role: Diagram SVG connector line stroke (.ex-ln)

tokens.name: --ex-status-good
tokens.role: Shared status accent: good/pass (table ● grade cell, matrix verdict cell) — green

tokens.name: --ex-status-good-bg
tokens.role: Shared status background: good/pass cell or glyph background

tokens.name: --ex-status-caution
tokens.role: Shared status accent: partial/caution (table ◐ grade cell, matrix verdict cell) — amber

tokens.name: --ex-status-caution-bg
tokens.role: Shared status background: partial/caution cell or glyph background

tokens.name: --ex-status-bad
tokens.role: Shared status accent: poor/fail (table ○ grade cell, matrix verdict cell) — red

tokens.name: --ex-status-bad-bg
tokens.role: Shared status background: poor/fail cell or glyph background

tokens.name: --ex-callout-note
tokens.role: Callout kind 'note': tag label + border/icon color (one of four kinds)

tokens.name: --ex-callout-note-bg
tokens.role: Callout kind 'note': full-width background

tokens.name: --ex-callout-caution
tokens.role: Callout kind 'caution': tag label + border/icon color

tokens.name: --ex-callout-caution-bg
tokens.role: Callout kind 'caution': full-width background

tokens.name: --ex-callout-key
tokens.role: Callout kind 'key': tag label + border/icon color

tokens.name: --ex-callout-key-bg
tokens.role: Callout kind 'key': full-width background

tokens.name: --ex-callout-aside
tokens.role: Callout kind 'aside': tag label + border/icon color

tokens.name: --ex-callout-aside-bg
tokens.role: Callout kind 'aside': full-width background

tokens.name: --ex-code-keyword
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: language keywords

tokens.name: --ex-code-string
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: string literals

tokens.name: --ex-code-comment
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: comments

tokens.name: --ex-code-number
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: numeric literals

tokens.name: --ex-code-function
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: function/tag names

tokens.name: --ex-code-punct
tokens.role: Code highlighter token color: punctuation/operators
